question: Should OpenClaw support a persisted per-group WhatsApp listen-after-mention mode in addition to the existing mention and always activation modes?
rationale: The patch is not only a local bug repair: it establishes two public configuration keys and a new group message-admission policy whose semantics become a compatibility contract.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in policy
options.body: Accept the default-off per-group listen window as a supported WhatsApp mode, subject to attached real behavior proof and clear lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Keep the existing two modes
options.body: Decline the new configuration surface and close or redirect the feature request rather than adding a third group-activation contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in policy
recommendation.body: Accept the default-off per-group listen window as a supported WhatsApp mode, subject to attached real behavior proof and clear lifecycle semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely repository-level product-direction owner; direct feature-history attribution was unavailable in this read-only review environment.
